scenario_meta.description: Below a planet-scale weather engine, vendors sell unfinished fogs, monsoons, hail songs, wind corridors, and drought endings before they are released into the sky. Build exactly six connected, functionally distinct market rooms and twelve socially entangled agents. Every weather lot should create concrete local changes to visibility, routes, inventories, bargaining leverage, and public safety. Include one or two large weather instruments or containers per room. Use storm-gray canvas, celadon instruments, electric-yellow kite silk, magenta warning thread, wet charcoal floors, and silver condensation in a coherent top-down pixel-art canon. Avoid neon cyberpunk, generic magic shops, Beijing references, signs, captions, readable letters, logos, and text baked into art.

uv_flashlight.self_outcome: {self} checks the surface under UV light and rethinks the story.

tea_flask.self_outcome: {self} takes a sip of tea and settles into the negotiation.

appraisal_slip.self_outcome: {self} rereads the appraisal slip and sharpens their judgment.
appraisal_slip.target_outcome: {self} shows the appraisal slip to {target}, narrowing the disagreement.

consignment_note.self_outcome: {self} checks the consignment note and recalculates the split.
consignment_note.target_outcome: {self} unfolds the consignment note for {target}, clarifying ownership and terms.

buyer_card.self_outcome: {self} checks a buyer contact and senses a better route for the item.
buyer_card.target_outcome: {self} passes a buyer contact to {target}, opening a possible deal.

loupe.self_outcome: {self} inspects the surface through a loupe and notices more detail.
loupe.target_outcome: {self} offers the loupe to {target}, inviting a closer look.

uv_flashlight.self_outcome: {self} checks the surface under UV light and rethinks the story.
uv_flashlight.target_outcome: {self} sweeps UV light across the item for {target}, exposing suspicious repairs.

packing_cloth.self_outcome: {self} wraps the item carefully and steadies the moment.
packing_cloth.target_outcome: {self} uses a packing cloth to help {target} handle the object safely.

tea_flask.self_outcome: {self} takes a sip of tea and settles into the negotiation.
tea_flask.target_outcome: {self} offers tea to {target}, softening the exchange enough to continue.

appraisal_slip.self_outcome: {self} rereads the appraisal slip and sharpens their judgment.
appraisal_slip.target_outcome: {self} shows the appraisal slip to {target}, narrowing the disagreement.

consignment_note.self_outcome: {self} checks the consignment note and recalculates the split.
consignment_note.target_outcome: {self} unfolds the consignment note for {target}, clarifying ownership and terms.

buyer_card.self_outcome: {self} checks a buyer contact and senses a better route for the item.
buyer_card.target_outcome: {self} passes a buyer contact to {target}, opening a possible deal.

loupe.self_outcome: {self} inspects the surface through a loupe and notices more detail.
loupe.target_outcome: {self} offers the loupe to {target}, inviting a closer look.

uv_flashlight.self_outcome: {self} checks the surface under UV light and rethinks the story.
uv_flashlight.target_outcome: {self} sweeps UV light across the item for {target}, exposing suspicious repairs.

packing_cloth.self_outcome: {self} wraps the item carefully and steadies the moment.
packing_cloth.target_outcome: {self} uses a packing cloth to help {target} handle the object safely.

tea_flask.self_outcome: {self} takes a sip of tea and settles into the negotiation.
tea_flask.target_outcome: {self} offers tea to {target}, softening the exchange enough to continue.
